body: A couple days ago I posted on inclusion and exclusion, and later in the day, while catching up with the mountain of emails that accumulate in my inbox whenever I’m on the road, came across this relevant article on a Ugandan Christian and retired bishop who has experienced exclusion for refusing to exclude lgbtq people. I have close friends who hold a wide array of views on this issue, but I hope that all will feel the pathos of this story.
